summary.result: The flood forecasting model was found to be applicable to real-time forecasting of water level fluc- tuations with reasonable accuracies.
summary.background: An water balance model was formulated to simulate the change in water levels at the estuary reservoir from sluice gate releases and the inflow hydrographs, and an one-di- mensional flood routing model was formulated to simulate temporal and spatial varia- tions of flood hydrographs along the estuarine river.
summary.method: The flood routing model which used the results from two hydrologic models and the water balance model simulated hydrographs that were in close agreement with the observed data.
